description: Requests a free RentSeek API key (100 credits) for an email address. Sends that address a RentSeek sign-in link; no key exists until the owner clicks it. The first request with `email` returns a `request_token`; a repeat request with `email` and `request_token` after confirmation returns the key once. Authentication is not required; requests are rate-limited per email and per client. The request costs 0 credits. It is not investment advice.

email.description: Email address that will own the key.

request_token.description: Token returned by the first call; send it after the owner confirms.

name: request_api_key
title: Request API Key
